scope: Twelve trials per version/scenario; each uses one fresh script/VM invocation in a fresh 32 MiB old-space process. Empty lyric/translation cache every session; seed=true supplies only playback metadata/palette. Empty-fallback scenarios start with no stored data and fetch public embed metadata. Native HTTP mocks return strings or binary according to requested mode; network latency is zero. Sample at invocation, HTTP and completion boundaries, drain callbacks after completion; no reuse of VM, compiled script or child process across trials. Process peaks include harness/core/VM/code-cache overhead; heap growth starts before fresh compilation. Not iPhone timings, native network buffering or VPN memory.
